missing_policy: complete required per score, otherwise null; product convention (official scoring tolerates 2 missing items with SUM.21/MEAN.21; not adopted)
source_note: Official scoring letter distributed by UW BRTC: total = sum of all 23 items (0-92); mean = average with at least 21 items answered, else treat whole assessment as missing. The BSL Supplement behavior items and the overall 0-100% self-rating on the form are NOT part of BSL-23 scoring and are not implemented.
